responsibility: Serializes the command-line option state that must accompany LTO bytecode so later LTO stages can recreate compatible compilation settings. It builds the opts section from decoded GCC options, explicit defaults whose meaning depends on target or driver state, debug and OpenMP/OpenACC settings, PIC/PIE and cf-protection modes, assembler options, and offload-specific options from target hooks. The result is the COLLECT_GCC_OPTIONS-style string consumed by lto-wrapper and related LTO drivers when merging and replaying options across WPA/LTRANS or offload compilations.
